items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I got a call to go to France to make a five day tour with Jo Jones, Milt Buckner, and T-Bone Walker.

ctx.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?

items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: We had Buck Clayton, Ed Lewis, Shad Collins, and Harry Edison. We had four trumpets now. Now we're building up the brass section

ctx.x: The trumpet? No, no, no, Shad had long gone. That was Joe Newman, because Joe Newman replaced Buck Clayton because Buck had gone into the Army.
When did Buck go into the Army?
